name: Deadlift
description: A deadlift is lifting a barbell from the floor to standing. Bend at the hips and knees to grip the bar, then stand up with the bar.

items.content: Barbell close to the body, over the middle of the feet
Arms straight, shoulders pulled down (lats engaged)

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Barbell on the floor, hips low, back flat, arms straight, hands outside the knees.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Standing tall, hips and knees locked, barbell held at the thighs, shoulders back.
